vex_evidence.summary: Email from Amy Keogh following Ben Carter’s disclosure of a suicide attempt. Instead of implementing a safeguarding plan, the email issues a threat that publicising communications would lead to withdrawal of support.
quoted_text: So Saturday night I tried to kill myself.
Publication of emails between you and the Fringe... will be considered an abuse of our good will... and will result in withdrawal of that additional support.
This is not trauma-informed safeguarding… this is retraumatising.

vex_evidence.summary: Brighton Fringe used the outdated 2024 Venue Managers’ Agreement to justify actions taken in 2025, including the removal of Ben Carter as a venue manager. Safeguarding disclosures during this period were ignored.
quoted_text: Brighton Fringe failed to produce or circulate a 2025 version of the agreement.
They breached this by ignoring my safeguarding and operational emails in April and May 2025.
No minutes or details were sent following the decision to remove me.
